CMOS three-bit Fibonacci LFSR
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 19.9n 40n)
.ic v(q0)=3.3 v(q1)=0 v(q2)=0 v(xdut.q0b)=0 v(xdut.q1b)=3.3 v(xdut.q2b)=3.3
XDUT vdd 0 q0 q1 q2 clk fb astra_084_cmos_three_bit_lfsr
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
